needscope.reading: Nandini and Amul crowd Belonging with cooperative heritage and family trust, while Arokya pulls between Belonging and Security on health reassurance and Jersey leans into Security on richness. Dodla straddles Vitality and Belonging on freshness. Heritage sits distinctively in Vitality — sociable, fresh, everyday warmth — leaving a clear whitespace to own farm-fresh daily vitality and bridge one thread into Belonging without abandoning its energetic freshness.

cb: Bought as one of several interchangeable daily milk brands, chosen on availability more than preference.
Consumed mostly at chai and cooking occasions; rarely the deliberate nutrition choice for the family.
Under-indexed with younger 25-34 mothers who default to Amul or Arokya by habit.
db: Actively chosen by the household nutrition-gatekeeper as her trusted pure-source milk.
Traded up across the franchise: toned milk to fortified, curd, and value-added variants.
Preferred for growing children and everyday wellness occasions, not just tea and cooking.
cb_ca_db_da.ca_quote: It's a good milk, one of the reliable ones we get here — I don't really think about which brand, as long as it's fresh.
cb_ca_db_da.da_quote: I choose Heritage because I know exactly where it comes from — pure milk from farmers, checked fresh every day for my family.
da_declarative: Freshness she can feel proud to serve.
cb_ca_db_da.caption: Layer verifiable pure-source freshness on top of Heritage's existing everyday trust — add conviction to the habit, never replace the familiarity.
cb_ca_db_da.shift_line: From dependable everyday milk to chosen pure-source vitality.

draft.smp: Heritage is pure nutrition, straight from the farmer's freshest milk.

smp_defence.why_collapses: Owns cooperative trust but competes on price and scale, not verifiable daily farm-source freshness for the family.
Owns national ubiquity but is too broad and processed-at-scale to credibly claim farmer's-freshest-milk intimacy.
Claims health-of-family but stakes wholesomeness, not a traceable pure-source-to-daily-quality-check promise.
Claims freshness regionally but lacks the scale of daily quality-checking and the vitality-led household nutrition ownership.
Leans on richness and reliability, not pure-source purity checked fresh every single day.
